notes.title: Coming Online - Mar. 26 Play Session Details
notes.content:
Servers are going live with our latest prototype build [b]Friday, March 26![/b] Join us for our play session windows from [b]3pm - 4pm and 6pm - 7pm Pacific![/b]

[url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/1385460/announcements/detail/2992052896965150099]Today we announced that [i]Drifters Loot the Galaxy[/i] is blasting into Early Access on April 15th![/url] This a huge step for the future of the game, and there's going to be some major changes to how we run these play sessions. Before we get into the nitty-gritty of this week's build, let's make sure you have all the info you need to hop in for our upcoming sessions.


[h2]The Times, They Are A-Changin'[/h2]

First off, [b]we're transitioning away from the Open Beta library entry we've been using to our full Early Access build.[/b] This means the "Drifters Loot the Galaxy - Beta" we've been using for our previous sessions will NOT be updated to the build required to access this week's session, and you'll need to [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1385460]download the new build through a new link[/url].

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1385460

This new build will appear simply as "Drifters Loot the Galaxy" in your Steam library. Once you launch it up for the first time, [b]you'll be required to sign back in to your Drifters Loot the Galaxy account[/b] (or create a new one if it's your first time joining us). Signing into your pre-existing account will ensure things like your Founder's Pack unlocks from Open Beta and our prototyping periods properly transfer over. [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/1385460/announcements/detail/2992052896965150099]More details on this can be found in our Early Access announcement.[/url]

Additionally, our server times are going to be a bit different starting with this session as well. For this week's session, servers will be online and available starting at noon Pacific and remain up for a full 12 hours. To ensure people are able to set aside some time to get matches in, we'll be focusing on a couple hour-long windows during this time period. That means you can attempt to matchmake at any point during the 12 hour window, but you'll be most likely to find full matches running from [b]3pm - 4pm and 6pm - 7pm Pacific.[/b] This is also the time we'll be hanging out [url=https://discord.gg/drifters]in our official Discord[/url], so you can pop in to ask questions and/or trash talk us at your leisure.

We've also mentioned that this will be the first time players outside the United States and Canada will be able to access the game. While this is still the case, we'd like to set some expectations. The servers on which matches will be running are all still based in the United States and we cannot guarantee a great experience for those physically further away at this time. [b]Importantly, if your ping spikes to or above 250ms, you may be kicked from matches in progress or be unable to begin matchmaking at all.[/b] This automatic process is in place to ensure other players have a smooth and fair experience in-match.



[h2]Tree Trimming[/h2]

While the major focus for our session this week is on the technical side, we do have some build changes worth mentioning.

[h3]Character Balance and Bug Fixing[/h3]
[list][*] Resistor's upgrade tree has been reworked[list]
[*] Rocket launcher lock-on is now default and no longer requires an upgrade
[*] Resistor's upgrade tree is more focused choices between buffing your primary weapon or your explosive abilities
[*] The upgrade allowing Resistor's mines to track nearby enemies has been removed[/list][*] Made changes to increase the reliability of Go-Go's House Call (teleportation ability)
[*] Made changes to increase the reliability of Sumo's Bottoms-Up (slam ability)[/list]
[h3]In-Match Optimization[/h3]
[list][*] Introduced improved HUD messaging for various situations such as killing an enemy, running low on energy, spawn doors unlocking, etc.
[*] Reduced the number of spots on VaporRedux that players may struggle to step over ledges[/list]
[h3]UI / UX[/h3]
[list][*] Added a button to manually refresh the server region list[list]
[*] Users with unstable ping may need to refresh to list available regions[/list][*] Overall UI polish pass, including new Store icons and Payload HUD updates[/list]



Things are gonna run a bit differently this week, but don't worry! If you have any questions regarding how to hop in or you're looking for more info, hop into [url=https://discord.gg/drifters]our official Discord[/url] and shoot us a message. 🚀

notes.title: Heads Up! - Mar. 5 Play Session Details
notes.content:
[b]Servers are going live with our latest play session Friday, March 5th at 4pm Pacific![/b]

In case you missed it: The Drifters Loot the Galaxy Open Beta has moved to a new format. Our goal is to focus on full development as we build towards Early Access. You can find more details regarding this change and the current session schedule [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1384870/discussions/0/2993169917932622670/]on our Steam forums[/url].

This week, we have several new changes to the HUD and improved player messaging in-match. Here’s what to expect...



[h2][b]Lost in the Chaos[/b][/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38550019/2a07e5fbd620f09252d9ca6d55453d9d9b5e2133.png[/img]

One of the consistent requests we’ve been getting from the community is more feedback on what’s happening in a match. Due to the fast pace, high-flying, 360-movement of the game it’s easy to get lost in the frenzy of the battle.  

We’ve heard your feedback and the team has been working on to improve our HUDs, player messaging, and in-match communication. We’re excited to show you some of the first steps we’ve taken to improve all of these things. 

Here’s some more details on what to expect from our latest build...

[h3][b]Updated HUDs and UI![/b][/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38550019/913fe45c8bafad22a56c7244a58144abaef848ea.png[/img]

We’ve made changes to several of the HUDs in-match including: 
[list]
[*] [b]Updated Player Info HUD.[/b] Including updated icons for health, energy, weapons and abilities.
[*] [b]Updated Tech Tree Menu.[/b] We’ve updated the Tech Tree “B” Menu, making it easier and quicker for players to navigate. We’ve also optimized the size of the menu to take up a smaller portion of the screen so players can see what’s going on around them while accessing the menu.
[*] [b]Updated Payload HUD.[/b] We’ve optimized the payload objective information to improve clarity and visibility.
[*] [b]Directional Hit Indicators.[/b] New hit indicators will now inform you on what direction you’re taking damage from, communicating more information to players on where enemies are attacking from.  
[*] [b]Directional Offscreen Indicators[/b]. We’ve added several new offscreen indicators that convey a range of new information:[list]
[*] Teammate directional location indicator
[*] Teammate current health status
[*] Game mode objective directional location
[*] Ping location (highlights pings called out by teammates)[/list]
[*] [b]KeyBind Menu Updated.[/b] Added new warning indicators for attempting to bind an action to a key that has already been bound, warning indicators for unbound actions, and the ability to reset keybinds to default.[/list]
[h3][b]More Player Feedback![/b][/h3]
We’ve added new messaging in-match to help communicate important moments in the heat of the battle.[list]
[*] Updated messaging for kills and deaths 
[*] New warning indicators for when enemies lock onto you. (Applies for Halley and Resistor lock ons)[/list]


[h2][b]Locking On...[/b][/h2]
Previously, Resistor’s Rocket Launcher (Q Ability) would automatically hone in on an enemy when activated. The feedback we got from this was that it made Resistor’s ability a little too powerful and easy to use.

Now to use Resistor’s Rocket Launcher, you need to aim your sights down on an enemy while Resistor’s targeting locks on. There is new UI to indicate when a target has been locked on. Once locked on, when you activate the ability, the rockets hone in on the enemy. You also have an option to activate Q to fire the rockets without locking onto an enemy.



[h2][b]Other Updates![/b][/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38550019/95a37482053d7e22559a6ded865cfa76ddfe62f0.png[/img]
[list]
[*] We’ve updated loot assets!
[*] Minor tweaks to VaporRedux level
[/list]


We’ve been hard at work implementing changes based on our community’s feedback! We really appreciate the support you’ve shown us throughout these play sessions and can’t wait to hear your thoughts. See you tonight. 🚀

notes.title: Getting Boulder - Feb. 19 Play Session Details
notes.content:
[b]Servers are going live with our latest play session Friday, February 19 at 4pm Pacific! 
[/b]
In case you missed it: the Drifters Loot the Galaxy Open Beta has moved to a new format. Our goal is to release new builds with substantial changes as we build towards Early Access to get the community even more involved in shaping the game’s development. You can find more details regarding this change and the current session schedule [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1384870/discussions/0/2993169917932622670/]on our Steam forums[/url]. 

Here's what to expect this week... 


[h1][b]Our Favorite Pile of Interstellar Rocks is Back!  [/b][/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38550019/22be77f9071d4574243e2e8c7e2bc40da2f4b987.png[/img]

Halley is back and has been reimagined with our in-match ability upgrades in mind. Halley is a long-range Juggernaut that can set up teams to do massive amounts of damage with his crowd control abilities.  

Halley deals damage by raining rocks at enemies from his trusty “Rock-it Launcher." Halley can lock down on target(s) with his weapon dealing heavy direct damage and AoE damage to nearby enemies.  

Orbital Strike (“Q" Ability) has been modified to summon ten meteors that orbit around Halley and absorb incoming damage. With Orbital Strike active, right-clicking will fire off meteors for quick damage and holding right-click while aiming at enemies will lock-on for an additional homing effect! 

Gravity Well has been replaced by a new ability called Immobilize Orb (“E” Ability). When it hits an enemy, it prevents them from grappling or drifting for a short period of time. Additionally, Immobilize Orb can also lock-on and track enemies in the same way as Orbital Strike by holding right-click. 

Halley’s ultimate ability, Black Hole, shoots a slower-moving orb that triggers when it hits terrain or when a player presses Z again to activate a large AOE sphere that pulls enemies to the center, holding them in place for a short duration.  

With these versatile abilities, Halley can be built to either specialize in crowd control or tanky brawling with the tech tree.  

 
[h1]Minion Zones [/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38550019/597a041335a04f156f0a99835a3f948d07540986.png[/img]

After lots of feedback and analysis, we’ve reimagined how the minions strategically function. Previously, you'd have to totally rely on a minion's random drop if you were trying to hunt down a particular consumable. Minions are now more organized into new minion zones with varying rarities, allowing players to target their loot-hunting more specifically. This also means map control over high-tier minion zones can very valuable if you're trying to turn the tides in a match! 

We’ve added two new minion types: Rare minions that are stronger, but with better rewards and Legendary minions that are downright lethal, but reap the best rewards.  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38550019/ba0ca94e271d34b0ae124c9288874753610d559d.png[/img]

We’ve added several “zones” on the map that have their own spawn timer. Common minion areas have a chance of dropping health packs and some loot. Rare minion areas will always drop a rare consumable and team loot.  

The Legendary minion zone will always drop a legendary consumable and a hefty amount of team loot, but don’t spawn until about halfway through the game, so team strategy is crucial to scoring this valuable loot! 


[h1]Other Updates! [/h1]
[list]
[*] We’ve added more VaporRedux level art! 
[*] Balanced and tuned GoGo's healing and damage 
[*] Buffed Resistor’s Rate of Fire 
[*] Added new consumable health pick up to instantly heal 
[*] Added a new consumable pick up that doubles damage on all weapon and abilities for a short duration 
[/list]

We’ve been hard at work polishing up our first build of the year and we can’t wait to get your feedback on all the major changes and additions, especially with Halley’s refreshed loadout! [b]Thank you again for all your support in getting us to where we are today, we couldn’t have done it without you. See you tonight. 🚀 [/b]

notes.title: It's All Fun and Games - Dec. 17 Prototype Details
notes.content:
Servers are going live with our latest prototype build [b]Thursday, December 17 at 4pm Pacific![/b]

In case you missed it: the [i]Drifters Loot the Galaxy[/i] Open Beta has moved to a new format. Our goal is to release new prototype builds with substantial changes every Friday to get the community even more involved in shaping the game’s development. You can find more details regarding this change and the current prototype session schedule [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1384870/discussions/0/2993169917932622670/]on our Steam forums[/url].

Here's what to expect this week...



[h2]Holiday Cheer[/h2]

It's been just over two months since the start of our Open Beta prototyping, and it's been a wild ride. The game has come a long way in that time with completely reworked characters, systems, and environments.

For everyone that has joined us for our prototyping sessions, thank you. Whether you're new around here or have been hopping in since closed alpha, your time and feedback has been invaluable in helping us evolve [i]Drifters[/i] into the game it needs to be.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38550019/0c6516a86bd520283cd20f19eb922d1dca0ea65e.jpg[/img]

As far as this week's build is concerned, it's a bit light. We've got a few of tweaks and optimizations, but that's not really going to be the focus. It's our last week before the team gets a well-deserved break for the holidays, after all, so this time around we're not going to be digging for feedback or pushing our excellent, hand-crafted surveys. Instead, we're gonna kick back, lock in some oddball team compositions, and have some fun!


[h2]Season's Greetings[/h2]

And now, a word from the [i]Drifters[/i] lead designer, Benson:

[i]Hey y’all Drifters!!!

First of all, right out the gate, a massive THANK YOU to every single one of you that has helped us make this game what it is with your time and feedback!! We know there are plenty of other games to be playing right now, so we’re extremely grateful to y’all for lending us your time and thoughts! Especially over these past three months as we’ve tried a different direction for the game. It’s been an absolute blast exploring ideas with y’all and seeing how everybody has been responding!

So we wanted to give a big hearty THANK YOU for this as we couldn’t have gotten here without y’all!

Looking forward to seeing everybody in the New Year as we keep pushing forward! Wishing all of you Happy Holidays and a Happy New Year!

- Benson[/i]



And that's it. Our last play session of the year is kicking off soon and we best get going. We've got big plans for 2021, but now's not the time for that. There's fun to be had and galaxies to be looted.

Until then, have a Happy Holidays. See you soon. 💜

notes.title: Finishing Touches - Dec. 11 Prototype Details
notes.content:
Servers are going live with our latest prototype build [b]Friday, December 11 at 4pm Pacific![/b]

In case you missed it: the [i]Drifters Loot the Galaxy[/i] Open Beta has moved to a new format. Our goal is to release new prototype builds with substantial changes every Friday to get the community even more involved in shaping the game’s development. You can find more details regarding this change and the current prototype session schedule [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1384870/discussions/0/2993169917932622670/]on our Steam forums[/url].

Here's what to expect this week...



[h2]Beware the Biason[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38550019/8684cbdc83bebbb65378b5fc8ce328d23d64d597.jpg[/img]

Last week, we welcomed the return of Sumo with open arms. He represents the last of our character classes to arrive in our weekly prototype format, the Juggernaut. Juggernauts like Sumo and Halley are meant to be the tanks of our universe, capable of soaking massive damage at the forefront of a coordinated objective push. It takes a lot of tuning to get characters like that just right, and your feedback has been invaluable in figuring out just what that tuning needs to be. 

You told us last week that Sumo feels appropriately powerful at close range but that the high-flying nature of the game makes it difficult for him to really excel. With that in mind, we've made several adjustments to make him a more viable damage-dealer at longer ranges. 

To start, we've introduced Sumo's right-click "aim down sights" to match Resistor and Ziggy. In addition to the extra zoom, you'll find that [b]aiming with Sumo also tightens the spread of his shotgun's pellet projectiles.[/b] This change arrives on top of additional general tuning to his shotgun which has had its damage drop-off range increased and pellet spread tightened as well. We expect these adjustments will enable Sumo to more effectively fight off enemy Drifters at longer ranges (and get those pesky battle GoGos off his back...). 

We also tuned and corrected some aspects of Sumo's Super ability to help him close the gap further. [b]When activated, nearby enemies will now properly be pulled into Sumo's deadly vortex and should no longer be knocked out of its range unintentionally.[/b]

None of these changes are meant to totally shake up how Sumo operates, but they are aimed to better illustrate Sumo as the Juggernaut he is. Don't get too close, no matter how tempting those hugs sound.



[h2]Looting the Galaxy 101[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38550019/0a320df8877405803d198201eec9c9ff7394d636.png[/img]

One of the major goals we've set for ourselves during this prototyping has been improving the new user experience. This comes in many forms, from building a more substantial tutorial to ensuring menus and UI elements are clear and easy to understand. Most recently, we updated our main menu and lobby UI with a new redesigned layout that focused on simplicity and ease of use. This week, we're introducing even more features, designs, and tweaks that build towards this goal.

The most substantial of these is our new Tutorial and a new Practice level. [b]Our Tutorial has been restructured to better walk new players through the basics of looting the galaxy,[/b] including our signature grapple and Driftpac mechanics. Afterwards, players can head into Practice to shoot, soar, and swing with the Drifter of their choice. It's a great way to get acquainted with our cast of galactic outlaws!

There are also some changes to in-match messaging. [b]New audio cues and HUD markers will be your guides to the objective[/b] and keep you in-the-loop on your team's progress, no matter where you are on the map. This and our new, simplified aiming reticle put focus on what's really important: escorting the dang Payload!



[h2]One More Thing...[/h2]

We've got even more changes in store for this prototype build thanks to your valuable feedback!
[list]
[*] [b]Updated layouts of the main menu and Drifters menu[/b]
[*] [b]Updated VaporRedux with new and improved level art[/b]

[*] Killing an enemy Drifter now has a chance to drop a Health Pack consumable 

[*] [b]Further optimized GoGo's tether[/b]
[*] Improved consistency of GoGo's initial tether lock-on
[*] Made line-of-sight with GoGo's damage tether less forgiving

[*] Damage-over-time from Ziggy's main weapon should no longer continue onto a target if the target's affected shield is broken
[/list]


This is our last major prototype build of the year and we're as excited as ever to get your feedback. It's been an incredible journey so far and we can't wait to show you what else we've been cooking up in 2021. But we've still got one more prototype play session after this week, so stay tuned! It's gonna be a fun one.

notes.title: Coming Out Swinging - Dec. 4 Prototype Details
notes.content:
Servers are going live with our latest prototype build [b]Friday, December 4 at 4pm Pacific![/b]

In case you missed it: the [i]Drifters Loot the Galaxy[/i] Open Beta has moved to a new format. Our goal is to release new prototype builds with substantial changes every Friday to get the community even more involved in shaping the game’s development. You can find more details regarding this change and the current prototype session schedule [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1384870/discussions/0/2993169917932622670/]on our Steam forums[/url].

Here's what to expect this week...



[h2]Who wants a hug?[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38550019/35fe6cf8a2b6730dc74aab08b98b55de3291dbd5.png[/img]

[b]Sumo is coming out swinging![/b] The beloved blue Biason returns to [i]Drifters Loot the Galaxy[/i] in this week's prototype build with some new capabilities and changes to fit into the game's current landscape.

For the most part, you'll find Sumo remains quite similar to how he played in previous Open Beta builds. With some help from Mrs. Copperbottom, he excels at crashing into unsuspecting convoys, soaking up damage, and dishing it out in close-quarters combat. Between his powerful shotgun and earth-shattering Bottoms Up ability, you'll want to keep your distance and stay out of Sumo's way as much as possible.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38550019/1f72487cf287d0a444bad08a21fa3a37c67c3c29.png[/img]

The major change you'll find with Sumo is his new Ability 1 (Q), Thick Skin. [b]As Sumo soaks up damage, you'll notice that a new meter above his health bar slowly fills up.[/b] Once you're out of battle, this bar will drain and slowly heal Sumo over time from its reserves. If you find yourself in the heat of a fight and looking for an edge, however, you can [b]activate Thick Skin to immediately grant yourself an overshield.[/b] This will immediately empty your Thick Skin meter -- the more you had in the tank, the more damage the shield can soak.

This new meter and ability replace Sumo's previous passive and allows him to have more deliberate choice over when, where, and why his additional health is utilized. He's joining the new battlefield as our first returning Juggernaut character and rounds out our full suite of class types You may not find Sumo's return as majorly disruptive to teamfights as GoGo and Ziggy were previously, but we expect him to fit comfortably into the dynamics we've seen evolving over the course of our prototyping. If nothing else, he'll be sure to draw a bit of extra fire!



[h2]Bottom of the Ninth[/h2]

A consistent piece of feedback we've heard over the last few weeks is that overtime in Payload can feel somewhat anti-climactic. Previously, as soon as the winning team outnumbered the opposing team on the objective, the game would immediately end with very little fanfare. This week, we're excited to introduce our reworked overtime mechanics just in time for Sumo's arrival.

[b]When the Payload match timer runs out, the game will immediately flip to overtime if the losing team has anyone currently contesting or escorting the Payload, even if the losing team doesn't have a majority.[/b] This is coupled with a 10 second grace period that kicks in if the losing team gets knocked off the point, giving them a small window to make it back and contest further.

A coordinated and skilled losing team should be able to be able to claw back a victory, but the previous overtime system simply didn't allow for that coordination and skill to shine through. With these changes, we're looking forward to more potential comebacks and exciting end-of-match moments!



[h2]But wait, there's more![/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38550019/98e5d0bf0fd26d71e5437d9adcfa25819c920759.jpg[/img]

We've got even more changes in store for this prototype build thanks to your valuable feedback!
[list]
[*] [b]Introduced our first pass of level art to VaporRedux[/b]
[*] The Payload has been updated with a new model

[*] [b]Made changes to improve the consistency of GoGo's tether targeting[/b]
[*] GoGo's tether will no longer break when looking away from a teammate as she's healing them

[*] Increased Ziggy's health from 500 to 800 to better fit into their new playstyle
[*] General tuning pass on Ziggy's main weapon

[*] Removed Resistor's Corruptionist specialization tree and consolidated to one tree for now 
 
[*] General tuning pass on Resistor

[*] General optimization and performance improvements
[/list]



It feels good to be back! We've got two more prototypes in the works for December before the holiday season gets into full swing, and we hope you'll join us for what we've got in store. See you there!

notes.title: Closing the Gap - Nov. 20 Prototype Details
notes.content:
Servers are going live with our latest prototype build [b]Friday, November 20 at 4pm Pacific![/b]

In case you missed it: the [i]Drifters Loot the Galaxy[/i] Open Beta has moved to a new format. Our goal is to release new prototype builds with substantial changes every Friday to get the community even more involved in shaping the game’s development. You can find more details regarding this change and the current prototype session schedule [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1384870/discussions/0/2993169917932622670/]on our Steam forums[/url].

Here's what to expect this week...



[h2]The Gas with the Golden Gun[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38550019/d06b59cd70837248f98fbac9c7c87635df9dad21.jpg[/img]

Last week's prototype build brought the return of everyone's favorite totally balanced ball of gas, Ziggy. We knew going into it that introducing a sniper to Payload was going to be disruptive, and we were ready to take in your feedback. Reception was expectedly mixed, but one pain point was very clear: Drifters sniping from afar moved combat away from the Payload and large team clashes became much less common. Ziggy's proficiency out-ranged most potential counters and made playing against them a frustration.

So this week, Ziggy is changing (again).

The most major of these changes affect Ziggy's trusty sniper rifle. [b]By default, Ziggy's primary weapon no longer has a scoped zoom.[/b] Right-clicking now punches your view in slightly over their shoulder, allowing you to focus in on a particular target without giving Ziggy total ranged dominance. Don't fret, though, hyper-snipers! You can still acquire Ziggy's original 2x scope in their re-balanced tech tree.

This is coupled with multiple changes to the sniper's ammunition. Previously bolt-action, [b]Ziggy's rifle is now a faster 5-shot semi-automatic affair that fires poison rounds.[/b] These new bullets deal less damage on impact, especially at further ranges, but apply a stacking damage-over-time effect to enemy Drifters.

As far as abilities go, Solar Wind has been replaced with Discharge. [b]Activating Discharge immediately unloads your remaining magazine in very quick succession[/b], dishing out some fast damage and poison stacks unto whatever poor soul happened to drift in front of Ziggy's rifle that day.

Their super ability has also been swapped out in favor of the new Golden Gun. [b]Ziggy loads 3 super-powered rounds into their rifle that are capable of putting enemies down in a single shot.[/b] In playtesting, we've found that moving Ziggy's one-hit capability to their super ability makes dying to it much less discouraging while retaining that satisfying feel that Ziggy mains love.

We're looking forward to hearing from you on how it feels to play as and against this [i]new[/i] new Ziggy this week!



[h2]One for All[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38550019/9b9a2d4f44cb2c785d9d122b4b757edffd70f3c7.jpg[/img]

Over the last few weeks, we've been experimenting with our new game mode, Payload. The aim of this mode has been to bring focus to a singular point on the map and more greatly inspire tighter team movement and strategy.

To encourage this even more, we've made a change to the loot you receive when reaching a checkpoint on the Payload's route. Previously, the loot that spawned from checkpoints made it feel like you were competing with your team for tech tree progress. This meant that teammates busy defending the point from hungry enemies would be punished for not trying to swipe loot away from their teammates.

Team Loot is meant to change this. [b]Collecting loot that spawns from Payload checkpoints now grants it to everyone on your team.[/b] This makes checkpoint loot significantly more valuable for everyone on your team, but it's also an even a greater target. Ambushing an enemy team and scooping up their loot just as they cross their checkpoint can quickly turn the tides of a match -- always keep an eye out for bandits!



[h2]Furthermore...[/h2]
We've got even more changes in store for this prototype build thanks to your valuable feedback!
[list]
[*] Resistor's right-click now functions as short-zoom iron sights, similarly to Ziggy
[*] GoGo's healing and damage tethers have been split between left-click and right-click, respectfully
[*] Loot chests have been scaled up for additional visibility
[/list]


Everything in this week's build is a direct result of the input we've received from you over the last several weeks of prototyping. As always, we thank you for sticking with us and helping to shape the future of the game with your feedback. 💜

You can find more details regarding this change and the current prototype session schedule [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1384870/discussions/0/2993169917932622670/]on our Steam forums[/url].

Here's what to expect this week...



[h2]"Pull my grapple..."[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38550019/1db223839c4796fb00e32c285525a4c7e4191830.jpg[/img]

[b]Ziggy storms into battle![/b] Quickly following up last week's return of GoGo and Sparky, everyone's favorite gaseous sniper is returning in this week's prototype!

Much like Resistor and GoGo so far, Ziggy has also gotten some major adjustments since the last time you may have played them. This isn't as substantial as what you've gotten to experience with GoGo's total rework, but many of these changes have had rippling effects on how the game controls as a whole.

Before we get to that though, let's start with what hasn't changed. [b]Ziggy's main sniper rifle and Ability 1 (Solar Wind) operate very similarly to previous iterations of the game.[/b] You will notice that their damage charge-up while aiming down sights isn't present though. This has been replaced with a flat damage boost while aiming while firing from the hip offers the same accuracy, but with standard damage. When it comes to clicking on heads, previous Ziggy mains should feel right at home.

Joining their arsenal is a new Ability 2: Smoke Screen. [b]Ziggy instantly drops a cloud of "smoke" that damages any enemies trapped inside over time.[/b] Smoke Screen is also the subject of several optional upgrades in Ziggy's initial tech tree, so be sure to experiment with all the potential paths!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38550019/71f38f69e854dc2daebb1d3f8e8a366fce80485d.jpg[/img]

Last but not least are the changes to Ziggy's super ability. Those that played in our prior alpha and beta testing phases may remember the terror of an enemy Ziggy ascending to the heavens and dropping one-hit kill lightning strikes on unsuspecting Drifters. While the spirit of this ability is still intact, it's been reworked in order to both accommodate for our new map layout and reign in its power a bit.

Using Ziggy's super ability [b]transforms them into a menacing purple-ish storm cloud[/b] that can roam around the map and zap enemy Drifters with ease. It controls similarly to typical drifting where Space and Shift move you up and down, respectfully. But be careful! Ziggy is still quite vulnerable in their super and can be counter-sniped by an accurate foe.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38550019/61643a37418b48e3119865051d6dd585332579fc.jpg[/img]

Ziggy joining the roster marks the third Drifter re-introduced into our Open Beta prototype builds. We hope this shakes up the game in the same way GoGo did last week and adds a bit more variety to the new battlefield.



[h2]Controlling the Chaos[/h2]
Now onto those "rippling effects on how the game controls as a whole." Ziggy's return made us re-evaluate one of the most consistent pieces of feedback we heard from Open Beta: scoping in with any key other than the Right Mouse button felt unnatural in a shooter. Previously we felt that this took too much emphasis off of grappling, a core movement mechanic that can easily decide a fight. Starting this week, we're experimenting with some changes to the default control scheme in response to this.

[b]By default, grapple is now bound to "F" and Right Click is reserved for alternate fire.[/b] Resistor and GoGo don't yet have use for this new alternate fire bind, but it's the perfect fit for Ziggy's sniper scope. This change accompanies another much-requested feature in that [b]you are now able to fire your primary weapon while grappling.[/b]

We encourage you to stick with this default layout for at least a few matches to get a feel for grapple's new home on your keyboard. It took us about 3-4 matches internally to shed some of the muscle memory built up over the game's development and we strongly feel that moving alternate fire to Right Click is an improved experience. If you just can't stand it, though, [b]both of these binds can be changed in the Controls menu.[/b]



[h2]Buildin' a Sentry[/h2]
New allies have arrived! [b]Three new consumable pickups have been added to the game in the form of summonable minions and turrets.[/b] Picking up and activating these consumables will show you a preview of where your new ally will be placed that you can relocate by moving your reticle. Once you've found your perfect spot, just Left Click to summon!

These consumables come in multiple forms from the rare (blue) hoard of familiar minions to the legendary (gold) massive turreted minion we've lovingly dubbed "Chester" internally. You may want to focus your team's fire if you see an enemy Drifter drop one of those near the payload...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38550019/4328599f8b1f44010f72b735f6f71bde68476f94.jpg[/img]



[h2]A Fresh New Look[/h2]
After evaluating tons of your excellent feedback regarding our main menu and UX, [b]our new main menu and pre-match lobby UX redesign is arriving in this week's prototype build.[/b] This new look focuses on clarity and ease of use, especially for new players just joining us. This redesign has been a long time coming and you may run into some hiccups here and there. Please make sure to report any feedback or bugs!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38550019/511400c78568f89fc03804ca3f66fd3a60d283f1.jpg[/img]



[h2]And a Whole Lot More[/h2]
If you couldn't already tell, this week's prototype is bringing with it a ton of major additions and changes worth mentioning. To avoid letting this post run way too long, we're going to very quickly go over these last few changes to ensure you're all up to date when you drop back in!
[list]
[*] [b]New loot chests have been scattered across the map[/b] that drop plenty of funds for those looking to upgrade. Now even pacifists can get in on the fun!

[*] Added a visual target indicator for GoGo's main tether.
[*] Tuned GoGo's tech tree economy in response to player feedback.

[*] Decreased payload movement speed.

[*] Tuned character hit detection.

[*] Tuned grapple and drifting mechanics.

[*] Updated consumable icons to replace placeholders and improve clarity.
[/list]


In case you couldn't tell, this week's update is pretty big. The Drifters team has been working incredibly hard to get these prototype builds up and ready for you all every week and you're going to start seeing even more of them pop up [url=https://discord.gg/drifters]in our official Discord[/url] during these sessions. They're here for some friendly conversation and competition and ready to hear your feedback.

Thanks for playing. 💜

notes.title: Need a Helping Hand? - Nov. 6 Prototype Details
notes.content:
Our next prototype build is rolling out and servers will be going live on [b]Friday, November 6 at 4pm Pacific![/b]

In case you missed it: the [i]Drifters Loot the Galaxy[/i] Open Beta has moved to a new format. Our goal is to release new prototype builds with substantial changes every Friday to get the community even more involved in shaping the game’s development. You can find more details regarding this change and the current prototype session schedule [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1384870/discussions/0/2993169917932622670/]on our Steam forums[/url].

Here's what to expect this week...



[h2]Initializing Support Functions...[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38550019/64ecc5330065524b259b90a7c20baee8cf01592d.png[/img]

[b]GoGo and Sparky are back![/b] They're the first to join Resistor in our brand new in-match progression system that we've been building out over the last several prototypes.

Things aren't quite as they were, though. GoGo's kit has been reworked substantially to fit into the new system and she plays quite a bit differently from when she last entered the fray. First and foremost, GoGo and Sparky are built to support your team, but GoGo's "fire and forget" healing and bubble shield abilities made her support feel very passive.

[b]GoGo's primary fire has been replaced with a lock-on tether beam[/b] that you'll activate by left-clicking. You'll be able to use this when you're within a certain radius of your target, whether that be a teammate or an enemy Drifter. When tethering to a teammate, you'll provide the typical healing-over-time that you'd expect. However, tethering to an enemy will have quite the opposite effect and deal damage-over-time for as long as you're tethered.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38550019/6160a2657158d661b9f0240bcaf16730f3b04eac.png[/img]

In addition to her primary fire, both of GoGo's main abilities have also been changed. [b]Her Ability 1 (Q) is now Duality, a targeted buff that acts similarly to her previous abilities.[/b] Applying Duality to a teammate will boost their damage output, while applying it to an enemy will make them slightly more vulnerable.

[b]Her Ability 2 (E) is also getting swapped out for a new movement tool, Teleport.[/b] As the name implies, this allows GoGo to teleport to a friend (or foe!) within range when aiming at them. This even allows her to phase right through walls and other obstacles, assuming the target isn't too far, of course.

To set expectations, this reworking of GoGo is very much a work-in-progress. [b]She currently has only one tech tree to progress through during a match[/b] and her new kit is subject to change. But that makes this a perfect time to hear your feedback!

We can't wait to see how this new introduction affects the game overall and we're excited to re-introduce even more of the original Open Beta roster in the coming weeks. Stay tuned and let us know who you want to see return next!



[h2]Pickup Permutations[/h2]
Last week, we introduced the first of what we're calling consumable pickups. These consumables drop randomly on kills, allowing you to scoop one up and use it at your leisure. After getting these into your hands and hearing your feedback, we're making some changes to the existing consumables and introducing a new one.

Regarding the current pickups, [b]the Portable Health Pack now heals over time rather than providing an immediate health boost.[/b] This change is directly influenced by your feedback that the previous functionality felt like a "free win" button in the middle of a close fight. Additionally, you'll find that [b]the Super Charge consumable has been removed entirely[/b] in this build.

Our new consumable type is Payload Boost. [b]This ultra rare pickup doubles the rate at which your team is able to push the payload for a limited duration,[/b] which can allow your team to get some crucial footing in a deadlock!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38550019/59f53e22fe8ccf41ae711dbab6732fddb1658745.png[/img]



[h2]Stronger Together[/h2]
While there's plenty of new additions and changes to try out in-game this week, we're also going to be trying out something a little different in our official Discord. [b]For a portion of this week's prototype play session, we'll be asking you to form parties and hop into separate voice channels with your teammates.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38550019/6276d9978eceedf469f830ab64abe4e1bd82dcfb.png[/img]

Now that we've spent some time with Payload and VaporRedux, we've found that this new mode does exactly what we hoped it would: foster stronger and more focused teamplay. The Payload and its path are natural focal points for teams to clash and much more actively encourages coordination within teams.

But coordination requires communication. These separate voice channels will act as a temporary substitute for the in-game communication tools that these prototype builds currently lack. We're incredibly interested to see how this, along our first support character, changes the way teams approach Payload.



Thank you all for your continued support over the last several weeks. GoGo is going to change the game significantly this week and we'll be reviewing every bit of feedback we receive. You should also expect to see even more new faces from the Drifters team join us in [url=https://discord.gg/drifters]the official Discord[/url], both this week and beyond. They can't wait to hear what you have to say.

See you tonight! 🤖

notes.title: Consuming and Corrupting - Oct. 30 Prototype Details
notes.content:
The next prototype build is almost ready for our play session [b]happening Friday, October 30 at 4pm Pacific![/b]

In case you missed it: the [i]Drifters Loot the Galaxy[/i] Open Beta has moved to a new format. Our goal is to release new prototype builds with substantial changes every Friday to get the community even more involved in shaping the game’s development. You can find more details regarding this change and the current prototype session schedule [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1384870/discussions/0/2993169917932622670/]on our Steam forums[/url].

Coming up in this week’s prototype build…



[h2]More to Consume...[/h2]
Our latest prototype experiment comes in the form of [b]new consumable loot drops[/b]. Much like the loot pickups you've seen in our past prototype builds, you'll find these new drops while you're taking out minion robots and eliminating enemy Drifters.

Unlike loot pickups, though, these drops aren't guaranteed on every kill (but you'll find they drop from enemy players much more often than minions). They're also instanced -- if you see a consumable drop, it's just for you. [b]No other players will see consumables drop from your kills, and vice versa.[/b] To pick them up, you'll need to physically grab the consumable either with your grapple or by flying through it.

Picking up the consumable will drop it into the consumable slot by your abilities. [b]Once you've got a consumable stowed, just press "T" to activate![/b] Keep in mind you can only hold one consumable at a time.

For this first implementation, there's two types of consumables you might see drop. The most common is the [b]Portable Health Pack[/b], giving you the chance to quickly regain health in the heat of battle. The second consumable type, [b]Super Recharge[/b], is a bit more rare. Activating this will speed up your ability recharge for a period of time, great for turning things around in a fight with an extra barrage of rockets!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38550019/d19f256969d880310c4d450c9bdf984a552d9f58.png[/img]



[h2]... Less to Corrupt[/h2]
We've also spent some time reacting to feedback from our previous prototype play sessions, starting with the upgrade specializations.

In this new build, Resistor's specializations have been altered to widen the gap between play styles. [b]Explosionist[/b] has been tuned more towards unleashing your onslaught of homing projectile abilities and is now a bit tankier. [b]Corruptionist[/b], on the other hand, is now the only specialization with Resistor's Corrupt ability and has been given more upgrades focusing on agility and movement. We look forward to hearing your feedback on these changes as we work towards introducing more characters to the new system.



[h2]The Floor is Vapor[/h2]
Our new Payload map, VaporRedux, has gotten even more changes in this new build as well. To start off, [b]spawn locations have been tweaked and new holographic signs have been added[/b] to help get new players where they want to go. These signs compliment the addition of [b]even more grapple bars[/b] placed throughout the map to help you string together that grappling goodness.

You'll also notice that [b]health pickups have been removed from VaporRedux[/b]. This has been done to shift focus towards the new Portable Health Pack consumables added in this build (and cut down on competition for a certain bubbly cyborg healer...).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38550019/f6457f6b3784da11523ea69acfe08e4ca6f9cb26.gif[/img]



[h2](Don't) Stop that Payload![/h2]
As a final note, the Payload game mode has gotten a change worth mentioning: [b]a single player can no longer contest a Payload against a whole team.[/b] The Payload's direction is now determined not by total control but by ratio of control.

For example, the Payload will halt if a single player from each team is escorting it at once. However, if another player shows up and turns it into a 2v1, the Payload will move in favor of the 2. This is meant to prevent sneaky Drifters from contesting the Payload while hiding under the map or a ramp like the cowards they are.



We're trying something a bit different this week with the new consumable loot drops and we'll be listening very closely to get your feedback. [b]The best way to leave that feedback, as always, is by [url=https://discord.gg/drifters]joining our official Discord[/url][/b] and hanging out with us during the session. Members of the Drifters team will be hopping in throughout the night to get your firsthand thoughts on these new additions and changes.

See you soon! 🚀

notes.title: Time to Specialize - Oct. 23 Prototype Details
notes.content:
[b]Our second Open Beta prototype play session is happening Friday, October 23 at 4pm Pacific[/b] and we’ve got some new changes to share! 

Before we get into what’s new, a quick reminder on what’s been happening: Drifters Loot the Galaxy Open Beta has moved to a new format. Our goal is to release new prototype builds with substantial changes every Friday to get the community even more involved in shaping the game’s development. Take a look at [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/1384870/announcements/detail/2907595185815152714]our post announcing these changes[/url] for more details. 

Coming up in this week’s prototype build… 



[h2]New Tech Tree Specializations[/h2]
The tech tree you first got to play around with last week has gotten a major overhaul. [b]When it’s time to buy your first upgrades of the match, you’ll now need to choose your specialization.[/b] This choice will determine what upgrade options you’ll have for the duration of the match with each specialization leaning towards a particular style of play.

With these new specializations come new abilities in Resistor’s potential arsenal. This includes the return of Resistor’s original Corruptor ability and a brand-new Decoy ability.

[b]Be sure to press Z prior to starting your first match![/b] This will bring up the tech tree chart and give you a chance to review your potential specialization paths before getting into the game.

[url=https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/38550019/080b6c6300b060c301b2174ed6320a8d71eb26d0.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38550019/080b6c6300b060c301b2174ed6320a8d71eb26d0.jpg[/img][/url]


[h2]Changes to VaporRedux[/h2]
Based on your feedback from our previous prototype session, we’ve also made some changes to our new Payload-focused map, VaporRedux. This includes a couple[b] new routing options for quick traversal to the payload track or one of the minion rooms[/b]. Plus, even more grapple bars and additional health pickups!

[url=https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/38550019/5c2b4eec0cbbc570fe667b6fef75d816760d84cd.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38550019/5c2b4eec0cbbc570fe667b6fef75d816760d84cd.jpg[/img][/url]


[h2]More Updates and Tuning[/h2]
We’ve also got a handful of additional tweaks and changes that you’ll notice once you get hands-on with the new prototype. Here’s a quick rundown on what else you can expect: 
[list]
[*] Respawn times have been reduced
[*] Tech Tree access has been moved to the “Z” key
[*] Minions now respawn twice as fast
[/list]
  


[b]Most of the changes you’ll see in this new prototype are direct responses to feedback from the community.[/b] We strongly encourage you to [url=https://discord.gg/drifters]join our official Discord[/url] and chat with us during the session, leave your thoughts in our #feedback channels, and fill out the post-session survey. Your words have greater impact than ever on the future of the game, and we’re listening very closely.

Thanks for joining us, and see you soon!

notes.title: New Ways to Play - Oct. 16 Prototype Details
notes.content:
Our first Open Beta prototype session is right around the corner!

[h3]It’s happening Friday, October 16 from 4pm – 8pm Pacific.[/h3]

In case you missed it: The Drifters Loot the Galaxy Open Beta is moving to a new format. We’ll be delivering brand new prototype builds every week with substantial changes that represent our vision for the future of the game. For the foreseeable future, Open Beta servers will only be online during these new prototype play sessions. More details and the latest play times, check out [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1384870/discussions/0/2993169917932622670/]our new status page on our Steam forums[/url].

So, what can you expect in our first prototype build?



[h2]In-Match Looting[/h2]
“Where’s the loot?” was one of the most frequent questions we got in the early days of Open Beta.

One of the first major new features you’ll notice in this week’s prototype build is in-match looting. [b]Throughout a match, you’re now able to acquire loot through multiple means and spend it to power up your character’s abilities.[/b] Currently, the primary ways of acquiring loot are…
[list]
[*] Damaging or eliminating enemy Drifters
[*] Escorting the payload
[*] Destroying minion robots
[*] Picking up loot scattered across the map directly
[/list]
You’ll see your personal loot total in the bottom left of your screen. This is the first look on ways you can acquire loot, so let us know what you think!


[h2]In-Match Ability Upgrades[/h2]
[b]Once you’ve banked enough loot, press the “Left Ctrl” key to open your character’s upgrade tree.[/b] From here, you can spend the loot you’ve acquired to upgrade and power up your character’s abilities for the duration of the match. These upgrades can include faster drifting, stronger protective barriers, and even infinite explosive ammo!

Keep in mind that this is merely a prototype! While some thought has been put into keeping the abilities from getting too crazy, this is not at all representative of our final vision in terms of balance. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38528414/cc0e9b8fa1c0ddf0a16a38f39aa81881c6424931.png[/img]


[h2]New Game Mode: Payload[/h2]
Also in this prototype is an early iteration of our latest game mode: Payload. The “payload” itself is a drone surrounded by a large circular zone. The drone spawns in the middle of the map between two opposing team bases. [b]Once a Drifter enters the payload’s area, the drone begins to move towards the opposing team’s base.[/b]

Similar to other payload games you may have played, the drone will move faster if multiple Drifters on the same team are escorting at once. However, the drone will not move either direction if Drifters from opposing teams are contesting the zone. Escort the payload all the way to the opposing team’s base to win! If the timer runs out, whichever team has the payload escorted the furthest will take the match. 

This is a very recent development, but we’ve already been having tons of fun with Payload internally and can’t wait to see how the community takes to it!


[h2]New Level: VaporRedux[/h2]
But what’s a brand new game mode without a place to play it? With Payload comes VaporRedux, a new map with a familiar skybox! [b]This new level was designed specifically with Payload in mind, featuring mirrored spawns and a payload path full of twists, turns, and tunnels.[/b] As you’d expect, VaporRedux has also been populated with a plethora of grapple ledges and bars to help you quickly swing back to the objective. 

[url=https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/38528414/f21ef0d2688425aed5640bb6eb6b1f87a73066bf.jpg][img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/38528414/f21ef0d2688425aed5640bb6eb6b1f87a73066bf.jpg[/img][/url]

That’s not all, though! VaporRedux also includes several rooms full of new AI minion robots. [b]If you choose to take a detour and eliminate some of these new minions, you’ll be rewarded with some extra loot to power up your abilities![/b] The aim of these minions is to supplement your supply of loot, especially if your opponents have already spent lots of time upgrading their abilities. 



[b]More than ever, we’ll be listening and reading every piece of feedback you’re able to give us.[/b] We encourage you to leave your feedback in our official Discord’s feedback channels and fill out the weekly play session survey once you’ve had your fill.

This prototype plays a lot different from the Drifters Loot the Galaxy you've come to expect and we can't wait for you to try it out. Thanks for sticking with us, there's much more to come. 💜

notes.title: New party system, ping system, and matchmaking improvements! (Open Beta 0.9.0)
notes.content:
Open Beta 0.9.0 is arriving soon! 🚀

The update includes the first iterations of our party system and ping system, tons of improvements to matchmaking, a bunch of bug fixes, and more!

Check out [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/1384870/announcements/detail/2896334282668267479]Benson's Open Beta dev blog[/url] and the full patch notes below for more details.

[h2]Major Updates[/h2]
[h3]Main Menu [Matchmaking][/h3]
[list]
[*][h3]Matchmaking optimizations![/h3]
- Bots will now dynamically fill in lobbies after a certain amount of time for faster matchmaking
- Separate matchmaking lobbies on the same region can now combine for faster matchmaking
- Various improvements to matchmaking messaging
[/list]
[h3]Main Menu [Social][/h3]
[list]
[*][h3]New party system![/h3]
- Invite Steam friends to join your party and match together!
- Manage your party through the new social widget
[/list]
[h3]Gameplay [HUD / UI][/h3]
[list]
[*][h3]New ping system![/h3]
   - Press "G" to place a ping marker for your teammates!
[/list]

[h2]Features & Tuning[/h2]
[h3]Main Menu [Exiles][/h3]
[list]
[*] Reduced the credit cost of unlocking new ability customizations by 90%
[/list]
[h3]Main Menu [Pre-Match][/h3]
[list]
[*] Strut your stuff! Players can now use their emotes in the pre-match lobby
[/list]
[h3]Gameplay [Characters][/h3]
[list]
[*] Introduced weapon damage fall-off across several characters
[*] Introduced weapon recoil to Halley, Hibbs, Sumo, and Ziggy
[/list]
[list]
[*] [h3]Hibbs[/h3]
[*] Weapon damage drops off to 75% when hitting a target at 100 meters
[/list]
[list]
[*] [h3]Resistor[/h3]
[*] Weapon damage drops off to 50% when hitting a target at 50 meters
[/list]
[list]
[*] [h3]Sumo[/h3]
[*] Weapon damage drops off to 50% when hitting a target at 30 meters
[/list]
[list]
[*] [h3]Ziggy[/h3]
[*] Ziggy can now remain scoped while reloading
[*] Introduced idle sway when aiming down sights, decreasing once a shot is fully charged
[/list]
[h3]Gameplay [Game Modes][/h3]
[list]
[*] Updated Capture the Relic visual effects
[*] Updated Capture the Relic messaging on the HUD
[/list]
[h3]Gameplay [Movement][/h3]
[list]
[*] Made various improvements to grappling mechanics
[/list]

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2][list]
[*] Addressed various issues that caused fatal crashes
[/list]
[h3]Main Menu [General][/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue that allowed interaction with other main menu elements when the player profile pop-up is on-screen
[*] Fixed issue that caused background image to be missing in the post-match loading screen
[*] Fixed various soft locks caused by pressing the Esc key on a pop-up
[/list]
[h3]Main Menu [Pre-Match][/h3]
[list]
[*] Addressed an issue that caused player to encounter error "client not network compatible" when failing to enter a game lobby.
[*] Fixed alternate loadouts not applying the proper abilities saved in that loadout
[*] Fixed an issue causing "Join Game Failed" errors after finding a match
[/list]

notes.title: Open Beta Dev Blog - September 2020
notes.content:
[b]Hey all you people drifting fabulously through the anomaly!![/b]

We have a really special update about to come online with the 0.9.0 release that we think will make a lot of you do a happy dance!! So I’ll keep this introduction short and get to the goods as that’s what y’all are here for!

[h3]Matchmaking Improvements[/h3]
We’ve done a LOT of refactoring to our matchmaking system thanks to the data we’ve been able to collect from the Open Beta so far. Again, we want to say THANK YOU for the help. We know it’s been frustrating. At the high level, you will be able to find matches much MUCH quicker than previously! If you want to know a bit about the details, then please read on.

The key improvements include:
[list]
[*] A min and max players server setting for launching a game (instead of just a min setting that we’ve had so far).
[*] Being able to merge groups of people that are waiting for a game on the same region. For example, if you have two different groups waiting to start a match, and both groups are below the threshold for starting a match, those groups will now join after a short period of time.
[*] We’ve also added a timeout that relaxes the settings and attempts to get a match started ASAP with whoever is available.
[*] A bunch of bugs we’ve hunted down that were creating bad scenarios in the matchmaking routine.
[/list]

[h3]Party System[/h3]
You’ve been asking for it, and here it is!!! Go team up with your buddies and jump in to start the lootin’!!

This is our first pass at the system, so it’s got the basics for now (being able to invite people to a party, joining a party, and the party sticks together until people leave). We have many enhanced features on the docket for the long term, so keep an eye on our updates as we expand this system in the future and please let us know what features you’d like to see in a party system as you continue to play.

[h3]Ability Unlocking Costs Balancing[/h3]
The cost to purchase an ability once it’s been unlocked has been drastically reduced. We have plans for a better ability upgrading path that does not involve Credits, but it’s a longer-term solution. For now, we wanted to get rid of a major pain point for character upgrades!

[h3]Ping System[/h3]
We’ve added our first pass on a simple ping communication system! Pressing G will place a Ping marker on whatever your reticule is over, and your entire team can see it. You can press and hold G to place the marker on yourself.

Next steps for this system will be to increase the number of object types it can be applied to, and to add contextual messaging based on the type of object that was pinged.

[h3]Emotes in Pre-Match Lobby[/h3]
We have a lot of plans for fun stuff to do in the Pre-Match Lobby in the future, and as a first step we’ve given the ability to randomly play one of the unlocked Emotes of the chosen character (if no Emotes are unlocked, the default emote for character will play).


There’s also a LOT of bug fixes and tuning that’s gone in based on the feedback we’ve been getting. Another big shout out to all of you that have been digging into the Open Beta and giving us this feedback, especially as we know the experience has been a little painful of late while we’ve been re-working our matchmaking system to provide a better experience. Thanks so much again for playing and enjoying the game!! We can’t wait to show you what we have in store for the future!!


Cheers,
Benson

notes.title: Open Beta Dev Blog - August 2020
notes.content:
[h2]Hey Drifters community![/h2]

We wanted to reach out and give a big THANK YOU to those that have been giving our labor of love a try!! It’s been so wonderful to see everybody playing the game, the responses, and feedback (positive or negative), and watching how y’all are getting along with our baby! We know there’s a lot of great stuff to play out there, so the fact that you’re willing to give us some of your valuable time is something we won’t take for granted! 

This Open Beta period gives us a lot of valuable data on issues we need to address, how best to address them, and great ideas for improvements and new features!

Speaking of issues, we’re definitely watching and listening to all your feedback. We know there are some key things causing more spice than Arrakis! So, I thought it would be worth giving a little update on what we’re working on and planning. 😊

[h3]Matchmaking Issues[/h3]
Yup…. This one stinks the hardest now.  It’s also the most complicated, so it will take some time to get right! We’re analyzing the data and dropping hotfixes quickly to address what we’re seeing, but this is also why we’re in Open Beta to find these issues. We appreciate your patience and help while we sort these little gremlins out. And sort them out we will!  (and we’ll get the team to stop feeding them after midnight!!)

[h3]Party System[/h3]
We have something in the works and want to get it to y’all several weeks from now if all goes well. So keep an eye out!

[h3]Lots of “Other Stufftz”[/h3]
We’re in the process of hardening our first client patch, with the hopes of getting it into your hands as soon as possible. There’s a lot of tweaks and tunings to improve responsiveness with grappling and weapons, a few tweaks to improve game mode clarity, and a lot of bug fixing!

[h3]Latency Issues[/h3]
Of course, we’re continuing to bolster our networking and backend systems to address some of the latency issues people have mentioned. This will be an on-going process, and things will get better over time! 


Again, we thank you for your patience and help in getting this solid, as this is one of the key reasons we needed to get into Open Beta.

Those are the main topics, but rest assured we have a lot of tender juicy morsels of fun in the pipe being worked on! Check out our announcement post for a high-level view of where we’re heading! And we’re keeping an eye on our forums, so keep posting, and we’ll answer as many questions as we can!!

Many many many many many many many many many many many MANY thanks for trying our game!! We wouldn’t be able to get this baby to where we want it without you!


Cheers,
Benson
